Script.name: truwer_core
Script.script:
-- truwer - rdzen czysto Lua: port 1:1 core pluginu Dargoth (index.ts 1.0.6) -- i rozszerzenia WWW (truwer.js 1.0.5). Paritet bajtowy dargoth === www === -- mudlet pilnuje repo arkadia-truwer-testy (suita B, wspolne fixtury). -- Regulamin (D6): JEDYNE miejsce wysylki do gry to core.wyslijBufor - -- wolane wylacznie ze swiadomej akcji gracza (Enter w polu promptera). -- Automatyka pauzy przesuwa tylko kursor, nigdy nie wysyla.
truwer = truwer or {} truwer.core = truwer.core or {} local core = truwer.core
-- stale (mirror index.ts) core.LIB_BASE = "truwer.library" core.COMMON_CHAR = "__wspolne" core.COUNTDOWN_TICK_MS = 200
-- punkty wstrzykiecia (testy deterministyczne; produkcja: getEpoch / -- math.random / tempTimer / killTimer) core._now = nil -- funkcja -> ms (jak Date.now) core._random = nil -- funkcja -> [0,1) (jak Math.random) core._armTimer = nil -- fn -> id (domyslnie: tempTimer co COUNTDOWN_TICK_MS) core._clearTimer = nil -- id -> nil (domyslnie: killTimer) core.charOverride = nil -- przyszle ustawienia GUI (fala 5) nadpisuja postac
local function nowMs() if core._now then return core._now() end return getEpoch() * 1000 end
local function rnd() if core._random then return core._random() end return math.random() end
local function tryCall(fn) if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end local ok, v = pcall(fn) if ok then return v end return nil end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Biale znaki ECMAScript (WhiteSpace + LineTerminator): trim/`\s` w JS -- dzialaja na tym zbiorze, wiec port musi byc unikodowy (UTF-8). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local JS_WS1 = { [9] = true, [10] = true, [11] = true, [12] = true, [13] = true, [32] = true } local JS_WS2 = { ["\194\160"] = true } -- U+00A0 local JS_WS3 = {} do JS_WS3["\225\154\128"] = true -- U+1680 for b = 0x80, 0x8A do JS_WS3["\226\128" .. string.char(b)] = true end -- U+2000..U+200A JS_WS3["\226\128\168"] = true -- U+2028 JS_WS3["\226\128\169"] = true -- U+2029 JS_WS3["\226\128\175"] = true -- U+202F JS_WS3["\226\129\159"] = true -- U+205F JS_WS3["\227\128\128"] = true -- U+3000 JS_WS3["\239\187\191"] = true -- U+FEFF end
-- dlugosc bialego znaku JS na pozycji i (w bajtach) albo nil local function wsLenAt(s, i) local b = s:byte(i) if not b then return nil end if JS_WS1[b] then return 1 end if JS_WS2[s:sub(i, i + 1)] then return 2 end if JS_WS3[s:sub(i, i + 2)] then return 3 end return nil end
local function trimJs(s) s = tostring(s) local i, j = 1, #s while i <= j do local l = wsLenAt(s, i) if not l then break end i = i + l end while j >= i do if j >= 2 and JS_WS3[s:sub(j - 2, j)] then j = j - 3 elseif j >= 1 and JS_WS2[s:sub(j - 1, j)] then j = j - 2 elseif JS_WS1[s:byte(j)] then j = j - 1 else break end end return s:sub(i, j) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- String(n) po JS: dziesietnie dla -6 <= exp10 < 21, inaczej naukowo "e±X" -- (bez zer wiodacych w wykladniku). Zweryfikowane offline na V8. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function renderJs(digits, exp10, neg) local sign = neg and "-" or "" if exp10 >= -6 and exp10 < 21 then if exp10 >= 0 then if #digits <= exp10 then return sign .. digits .. string.rep("0", exp10 - #digits + 1) end local whole = digits:sub(1, exp10 + 1) local frac = digits:sub(exp10 + 2) if frac == "" then return sign .. whole end return sign .. whole .. "." .. frac end return sign .. "0." .. string.rep("0", -exp10 - 1) .. digits end local mant = digits:sub(1, 1) if #digits > 1 then mant = mant .. "." .. digits:sub(2) end local es = exp10 >= 0 and ("e+" .. exp10) or ("e-" .. (-exp10)) return sign .. mant .. es end
function core.fmtNum(n) if n ~= n then return "NaN" end if n == math.huge then return "Infinity" end if n == -math.huge then return "-Infinity" end if n == 0 then return "0" end -- pokrywa -0 local neg = n < 0 local a = math.abs(n) local digits, exp10 for p = 1, 17 do local s = string.format("%." .. (p - 1) .. "e", a) if tonumber(s) == a then local mant, ex = s:match("^([0-9.]+)e([+-]%d+)$") digits = mant:gsub("%.", "") exp10 = tonumber(ex) break end end if not digits then local s = string.format("%.16e", a) local mant, ex = s:match("^([0-9.]+)e([+-]%d+)$") digits = mant:gsub("%.", "") exp10 = tonumber(ex) end return renderJs(digits, exp10, neg) end
-- String(v) po JS dla wartosci z brudnego wejscia (normKrok.tekst) local function jsString(v) local t = type(v) if t == "number" then return core.fmtNum(v) end if t == "boolean" then return v and "true" or "false" end if t == "table" then if #v > 0 then local parts = {} for i = 1, #v do parts[i] = jsString(v[i]) end return table.concat(parts, ",") end return "[object Object]" end return tostring(v) end
local function isFiniteNum(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge end
-- Array.isArray + map po indeksach: tabela jest "tablica", gdy wszystkie -- klucze sa dodatnimi intami (pusta = tablica; JSON-owy null z yajl zostawia -- dziure, wiec iteracja idzie po posortowanych kluczach, nie ipairs). local function arrayValues(t) if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end local keys = {} for k in pairs(t) do if type(k) ~= "number" or k < 1 or k % 1 ~= 0 then return nil end keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys) local out = {} for _, k in ipairs(keys) do out[#out + 1] = t[k] end return out end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- genId: "s" + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8) -- Naiwna petla base36 dokladna dla 6 cyfr frakcji (dowiedzione offline -- na 10000 losowaniach LCG: wszystkie operacje posrednie dokladne w double). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local D36 = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
local function base36int(n) n = math.floor(n) if n == 0 then return "0" end local out = {} while n > 0 do local r = n % 36 out[#out + 1] = D36:sub(r + 1, r + 1) n = math.floor(n / 36) end local rev = {} for i = #out, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = out[i] end return table.concat(rev) end
local function base36frac6(r) if r <= 0 then return "" end local out = {} for i = 1, 6 do r = r * 36 local d = math.floor(r) out[i] = D36:sub(d + 1, d + 1) r = r - d end return table.concat(out) end
function core.genId() return "s" .. base36int(nowMs()) .. base36frac6(rnd()) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Warianty: split po "|", trim kazdego, odrzucenie pustych -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function splitRaw(t) local out, pos = {}, 1 while true do local i = string.find(t, "|", pos, true) if not i then out[#out + 1] = string.sub(t, pos) break end out[#out + 1] = string.sub(t, pos, i - 1) pos = i + 1 end return out end
function core.splitVariants(t) local out = {} for _, piece in ipairs(splitRaw(tostring(t))) do local v = trimJs(piece) if #v > 0 then out[#out + 1] = v end end return out end
function core.pickVariant(t) local v = core.splitVariants(t) if #v == 0 then return trimJs(t) end return v[math.floor(rnd() * #v) + 1] end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DSL: PAUSE_RE = ^\/pauza(?:\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?))?$ (case-insensitive) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- zwraca: true, sekundy|nil dla pauzy; nil dla zwyklej linii local function matchPause(line) local pos = line:match("^/[Pp][Aa][Uu][Zz][Aa]()") if not pos then return nil end local rest = line:sub(pos) if rest == "" then return true, nil end -- "/pauza" bez argumentu local i = 1 local hadWs = false while true do local l = wsLenAt(rest, i) if not l then break end hadWs = true i = i + l end if not hadWs then return nil end local num = rest:sub(i) if not num:match("^%d+%.%d+$") and not num:match("^%d+$") then return nil end return true, tonumber(num) end
function core.krokiFromDsl(text) local out = {} text = tostring(text) -- split(/\r?\n/): samotny \r NIE jest separatorem local pos = 1 while true do local nl = text:find("\n", pos, true) local raw = nl and text:sub(pos, nl - 1) or text:sub(pos) if raw:sub(-1) == "\r" then raw = raw:sub(1, -2) end local line = trimJs(raw) if line ~= "" then local isPause, sekundy = matchPause(line) if isPause then out[#out + 1] = { typ = "pauza", sekundy = sekundy } elseif line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then local t = line:sub(2) local l = wsLenAt(t, 1) if l then t = t:sub(1 + l) end out[#out + 1] = { typ = "nota", tekst = t } else out[#out + 1] = { typ = "cmd", tekst = line } end end if not nl then break end pos = nl + 1 end return out end
function core.dslFromKroki(kroki) local out = {} for i, k in ipairs(kroki) do if k.typ == "pauza" then out[i] = k.sekundy ~= nil and ("/pauza " .. core.fmtNum(k.sekundy)) or "/pauza" elseif k.typ == "nota" then out[i] = "# " .. (k.tekst or "") else out[i] = k.tekst or "" end end return table.concat(out, "\n") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Normalizacja scen -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.normKrok(k) if type(k) ~= "table" then return nil end if k.typ == "pauza" then local s = k.sekundy if not (isFiniteNum(s) and s >= 0) then s = nil end return { typ = "pauza", sekundy = s } end if k.typ == "nota" then return { typ = "nota", tekst = k.tekst == nil and "" or jsString(k.tekst) } end return { typ = "cmd", tekst = k.tekst == nil and "" or jsString(k.tekst) } end
local function normKrokiOf(o) local kroki = {} local arr = arrayValues(o.kroki) if arr then for _, v in ipairs(arr) do local nk = core.normKrok(v) if nk then kroki[#kroki + 1] = nk end end end return kroki end
function core.normScene(o) if type(o) ~= "table" then return nil end local now = nowMs() return { id = (type(o.id) == "string" and o.id ~= "") and o.id or core.genId(), tytul = type(o.tytul) == "string" and o.tytul or "Scena", autor = type(o.autor) == "string" and o.autor or "", utworzono = isFiniteNum(o.utworzono) and o.utworzono or now, zmodyfikowano = isFiniteNum(o.zmodyfikowano) and o.zmodyfikowano or now, kroki = normKrokiOf(o), } end
function core.sceneFromDsl(text, title) local now = nowMs() return { id = core.genId(), tytul = title, autor = "", utworzono = now, zmodyfikowano = now, kroki = core.krokiFromDsl(text), } end
function core.sceneFromJson(o) if type(o) ~= "table" then error("bad json") end local now = nowMs() return { id = core.genId(), -- zawsze swieze id (import nie dziedziczy) tytul = type(o.tytul) == "string" and o.tytul or "Importowana scena", autor = type(o.autor) == "string" and o.autor or "", utworzono = isFiniteNum(o.utworzono) and o.utworzono or now, zmodyfikowano = isFiniteNum(o.zmodyfikowano) and o.zmodyfikowano or now, kroki = normKrokiOf(o), } end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) po JS - tylko schemat truwera (stala kolejnosc -- kluczy; escaping jak JSON.stringify: cudzyslow i backslash, kontrolki 8/12/10/13/9 jako b/f/n/r/t, pozostale bajty ponizej 0x20 jako u00XX malymi literami; surowe UTF-8. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function jsonStr(s) s = tostring(s) local parts = { '"' } for i = 1, #s do local b = s:byte(i) local ch = s:sub(i, i) if ch == '"' then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\"' elseif ch == '\\' then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\\\' elseif b == 8 then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\b' elseif b == 12 then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\f' elseif b == 10 then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\n' elseif b == 13 then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\r' elseif b == 9 then parts[#parts + 1] = '\\t' elseif b < 32 then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format('\\u%04x', b) else parts[#parts + 1] = ch end end parts[#parts + 1] = '"' return table.concat(parts) end
-- JSON.stringify(NaN/Infinity) = "null" (scen z takimi liczbami nie ma, -- ale strzegmy zgodnosci) local function jsonNum(n) if not isFiniteNum(n) then return "null" end return core.fmtNum(n) end
local function pad2sp(lvl) return string.rep(" ", lvl) end
local function writeKrokJson(k, lvl) local lines = { pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"typ": ' .. jsonStr(k.typ) } if k.tekst ~= nil then lines[#lines + 1] = pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"tekst": ' .. jsonStr(k.tekst) end if k.sekundy ~= nil then lines[#lines + 1] = pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"sekundy": ' .. jsonNum(k.sekundy) end return "{\n" .. table.concat(lines, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad2sp(lvl) .. "}" end
local function writeKrokiArr(kroki, lvl) if #kroki == 0 then return "[]" end local parts = {} for i, k in ipairs(kroki) do parts[i] = pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. writeKrokJson(k, lvl + 1) end return "[\n" .. table.concat(parts, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad2sp(lvl) .. "]" end
-- koperta truwer-scene (format/wersja/tytul/autor/utworzono/zmodyfikowano/kroki) local function writeSceneJson(s, lvl) local lines = { pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"format": "truwer-scene"', pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"wersja": 1', pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"tytul": ' .. jsonStr(s.tytul), pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"autor": ' .. jsonStr(s.autor), pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"utworzono": ' .. jsonNum(s.utworzono), pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"zmodyfikowano": ' .. jsonNum(s.zmodyfikowano), pad2sp(lvl + 1) .. '"kroki": ' .. writeKrokiArr(s.kroki or {}, lvl + 1), } return "{\n" .. table.concat(lines, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad2sp(lvl) .. "}" end
function core.jsonFromScene(s) return writeSceneJson(s, 0) end
function core.bulkJson(scenes) local sceny if #scenes == 0 then sceny = "[]" else local parts = {} for i, s in ipairs(scenes) do parts[i] = pad2sp(2) .. writeSceneJson(s, 2) end sceny = "[\n" .. table.concat(parts, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad2sp(1) .. "]" end return "{\n" .. ' "format": "truwer-scenes",\n' .. ' "wersja": 1,\n' .. ' "sceny": ' .. sceny .. "\n" .. "}" end
function core.bulkTxt(scenes) local out = {} for i, s in ipairs(scenes) do local t = s.tytul if t == nil or t == "" then t = "(bez tytulu)" end out[i] = "=== " .. t .. " ===\n" .. core.dslFromKroki(s.kroki or {}) end return table.concat(out, "\n\n") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Nazwy plikow / detekcja JSON -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.safeName(s) local out = s if out == nil or out == "" then out = "scena" end -- JS: s || "scena" out = tostring(out):gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_") out = out:gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", "") if out == "" then out = "scena" end return out end
function core.baseName(name) local s = tostring(name or "") s = s:gsub(".*[\\/]", "") s = s:gsub("%.[^.]+$", "") if s == "" then s = "Importowana scena" end return s end
function core.isJson(text, name) local n = tostring(name or ""):lower() if n:match("%.json$") then return true end return trimJs(text):sub(1, 1) == "{" end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Nawigacja po krokach (indeksy 0-based jak w JS; dostep kroki[i + 1]) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.firstPlayable(kroki, from) local n = #kroki local i = math.max(0, from) while i < n do if kroki[i + 1].typ ~= "nota" then return i end i = i + 1 end return n end
function core.prevPlayable(kroki, from) local i = math.min(#kroki - 1, from) while i >= 0 do if kroki[i + 1].typ ~= "nota" then return i end i = i - 1 end return -1 end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Import (tekst DSL albo JSON: pojedyncza scena / pakiet truwer-scenes / -- gola tablica). Bledny JSON -> error (GUI pokazuje "Blad importu."). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.importScenes(text, dslTitle, jsonName) text = tostring(text) if not core.isJson(text, jsonName) then return { core.sceneFromDsl(text, dslTitle) } end local ok, parsed = pcall(yajl.to_value, text) if not ok then error("bad json") end local arr if trimJs(text):sub(1, 1) == "[" then -- Array.isArray(parsed): dla poprawnego JSON-a rownowazne z "[" na -- poczatku (yajl nie rozroznia [] od {}, ale oba daja 0 scen) arr = arrayValues(parsed) or {} elseif type(parsed) == "table" and type(parsed.sceny) == "table" then arr = arrayValues(parsed.sceny) or {} else arr = { parsed } end local out = {} for _, v in ipairs(arr) do out[#out + 1] = core.sceneFromJson(v) end return out end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Storage per postac (D2): <profil>/truwer/library.<postac>.lua -- prefs per profil: <profil>/truwer/prefs.lua -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function profileDir() return tostring(getMudletHomeDir()) end
local function storagePath(name) return profileDir() .. "/truwer/" .. name .. ".lua" end
local function ensureDir() -- table.save nie tworzy katalogow; lfs jest w Mudlecie, ale strzegmy sie if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, profileDir() .. "/truwer") end end
function core.charName() local ov = core.charOverride if type(ov) == "string" and trimJs(ov) ~= "" then return trimJs(ov) end local c = tryCall(getCharacterName) if type(c) == "string" and trimJs(c) ~= "" then return trimJs(c) end local p = tryCall(getProfileName) if type(p) == "string" and trimJs(p) ~= "" then return trimJs(p) end return core.COMMON_CHAR end
function core.charKey() return core.LIB_BASE .. "." .. core.charName() end
function core.libraryPath() return storagePath("library." .. core.charName()) end
function core.prefsPath() return storagePath("prefs") end
function core.loadLibrary() local t = table.load(core.libraryPath()) local out = {} local arr = arrayValues(t) if arr then for _, v in ipairs(arr) do local ns = core.normScene(v) if ns then out[#out + 1] = ns end end end core.state.library = out return out end
function core.saveLibrary() ensureDir() local ok = pcall(table.save, core.libraryPath(), core.state.library) if not ok then return nil, "Blad zapisu biblioteki." end return true end
function core.addScenes(scenes) for _, s in ipairs(scenes) do core.state.library[#core.state.library + 1] = s end core.saveLibrary() end
function core.loadPrefs() local t = table.load(core.prefsPath()) if type(t) == "table" and type(t.autoCursor) == "boolean" then core.state.autoCursor = t.autoCursor else core.state.autoCursor = true -- JS: brak klucza -> true end return core.state.autoCursor end
function core.savePrefs() ensureDir() return pcall(table.save, core.prefsPath(), { autoCursor = core.state.autoCursor }) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Maszyna odtwarzania (mirror stanu i akcji index.ts: cursor 0-based, -- playBuffer, autoCursor). GUI dojdzie w falach 2-4; rdzen jest kompletny -- i testowalny bez GUI. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- core.state = core.state or { library = {}, currentId = nil, cursor = 0, playBuffer = "", autoCursor = true, pauseRemainMs = nil, }
function core.currentScene() for _, s in ipairs(core.state.library) do if s.id == core.state.currentId then return s end end return nil end
function core.primeBuffer() local s = core.currentScene() if not s then core.state.playBuffer = "" return end local k = s.kroki[core.state.cursor + 1] core.state.playBuffer = (k and k.typ == "cmd") and core.pickVariant(k.tekst) or "" end
function core.openScene(id, mode) core.state.currentId = id if mode == "play" then local s = core.currentScene() if s then core.state.cursor = core.firstPlayable(s.kroki, 0) core.primeBuffer() end end end
function core.stopPause() local st = core.state if st._pauseTimerId ~= nil then local clear = core._clearTimer if clear == nil and type(killTimer) == "function" then clear = killTimer end if clear then pcall(clear, st._pauseTimerId) end st._pauseTimerId = nil end st._pauseStart = nil st._pauseTotal = nil st.pauseRemainMs = nil end
function core.advance() local s = core.currentScene() if not s then return end core.stopPause() core.state.cursor = core.firstPlayable(s.kroki, core.state.cursor + 1) core.primeBuffer() end
function core.back() local s = core.currentScene() if not s then return end core.stopPause() local target = core.state.cursor >= #s.kroki and (#s.kroki - 1) or (core.state.cursor - 1) local p = core.prevPlayable(s.kroki, target) core.state.cursor = p < 0 and core.firstPlayable(s.kroki, 0) or p core.primeBuffer() end
function core.stop() local s = core.currentScene() if not s then return end core.stopPause() core.state.cursor = core.firstPlayable(s.kroki, 0) core.primeBuffer() end
function core.activateStep(i) local s = core.currentScene() if not s then return end if i < 0 or i >= #s.kroki then return end if s.kroki[i + 1].typ == "nota" then return end core.stopPause() core.state.cursor = i core.primeBuffer() end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Odliczanie pauzy (mirror startPauseTimer/stopPauseTimer; COUNTDOWN_TICK_MS -- = 200). Produkcja: one-shot tempTimer uzbrajany ponownie po kazdym ticku -- (rownowazne setInterval z JS). Koniec odliczania: tylko przesuniecie -- kursora przy autoCursor - ZADNEJ wysylki (regulamin). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.startPause(seconds) core.stopPause() local st = core.state st._pauseTotal = seconds * 1000 st._pauseStart = nowMs() core._pauseTick() -- JS: tick() przed setInterval end
function core._pauseTick() local st = core.state if st._pauseTotal == nil then return end local rem = math.max(0, st._pauseTotal - (nowMs() - st._pauseStart)) st.pauseRemainMs = rem if rem <= 0 then st._pauseTimerId = nil st._pauseStart = nil st._pauseTotal = nil if st.autoCursor then core.advance() end else local arm = core._armTimer if arm == nil and type(tempTimer) == "function" then arm = function(fn) return tempTimer(core.COUNTDOWN_TICK_MS / 1000, fn) end end if arm then st._pauseTimerId = arm(function() core._pauseTick() end) end end end
function core.fmtCountdown(remMs) return string.format("%.1f", remMs / 1000) .. "s" end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- JEDYNE miejsce wysylki do gry (D6): wolane wylacznie ze swiadomej akcji -- gracza (Enter w polu promptera / przycisk). Pusty bufor = blad, zero -- wysylki, kursor stoi. Po udanej wysylce: advance. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function core.wyslijBufor() local text = trimJs(core.state.playBuffer) if text == "" then return nil, "Pusta komenda." end -- JS: send w try/catch, advance ZAWSZE po probie (finally) local ok = pcall(send, text) core.advance() if not ok then return nil, "Blad wyslania komendy." end return text end

Script.name: truwer_init
Script.script:
-- truwer - asystent scenek RP dla Mudleta (port pluginu Dargoth/WWW). -- Spiewanie, recytacja, odgrywanie scen krok po kroku z prompterem. -- Fala 0: szkielet pakietu (banner wersji + pomoc). Rdzen, biblioteka, -- prompter i edytor GUI laduja w kolejnych falach.
truwer = truwer or {}
do
local PLUGIN_VERSION = "1.0.0m" local PLUGIN_BUILD = "08-09-2026"
truwer.version = PLUGIN_VERSION truwer.build = PLUGIN_BUILD
function truwer.banner() return "Truwer " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. " (build " .. PLUGIN_BUILD .. ") - port w trakcie budowy." end
function truwer.onAlias() cecho("<green>" .. truwer.banner() .. "<reset>\n") end
function truwer.onPomoc() cecho("<green>" .. truwer.banner() .. "<reset>\n") cecho("Aliasy:\n") cecho(" <yellow>/truwer<reset> - banner wersji\n") cecho(" <yellow>/truwer pomoc<reset> - ten tekst\n") cecho("Pelna pomoc i alias /truwer aktualizuj dojda z updaterem w fali 5.\n") end
end
